news.title: Anderon, an IBM Company, Finalizes Agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce for a $1 Billion CHIPS Award
news.summary_en: The award will accelerate Anderon’s R&D efforts to advance the nation's quantum wafer manufacturing capabilities.

news.title: Chain Reaction Innovations opens applications for its 2027 cohort
news.summary_en: Argonne National Laboratory's Chain Reaction Innovations program is now accepting applications from technical founders working on early-stage energy and science technologies, offering a $115k annual stipend, non-dilutive funding, and direct access to Argonne's labs and experts. Applications close October 30, 2026.
